searchText: We made an [interim release ](https://github.com/erigontech/zilkworm/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.2-ere) with ready ere-benchmarks support: A follow-up PR would be created on eth-act/zkevm-benchmark-workload with [this commit ](https://github.com/erigontech/zkevm-benchmark-workload/commit/3b3b95fec894f211607c547d7d36fa3b136d40da) Highlights: - zilkworm's codebase has all the support necessary for the workload side to directly run the benchmark - the custom input version (soon to be replaced) has a custom rust script also readily integrated Further coordination and easy instructions coming soon. Adding <@745384946310578317> who worked on this. <@944007601400741989> We can discuss further on this. Sharing what <@745384946310578317> shared internally some time ago on this (comparison to reth). ``` Metric | Value -- | -- Comparable fixtures | 940 / 940 Zilkworm wins | 785 (83.5%) Reth wins | 155 (16.5%) Total cycles, Reth | 278,152,233,848 Total cycles, Zilkworm | 142,815,715,725 Aggregate speedup | 1.95× in Zilkworm's favor ``` This only has sp1 hypercube support at the moment

We made an [interim release ](https://github.com/erigontech/zilkworm/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.2-ere) with ready ere-benchmarks support: 

A follow-up PR would be created on eth-act/zkevm-benchmark-workload with [this commit ](https://github.com/erigontech/zkevm-benchmark-workload/commit/3b3b95fec894f211607c547d7d36fa3b136d40da)

Highlights: 
- zilkworm's codebase has all the support necessary for the workload side to directly run the benchmark
- the custom input version (soon to be replaced) has a custom rust script also readily integrated

Further coordination and easy instructions coming soon. Adding <@745384946310578317> who worked on this.
